accuracyFlags: 'Booderee National Park ... charges its own entry fee separate from NSW parks': correct (Commonwealth park) but give the 2026 fee and link; same for NSW 'All Parks Pass' price (page gives none).
'Murramarang and Booderee campgrounds sell out months ahead' unsourced; NSW National Parks booking window ('rolling window') stated without dates.
Whale migration 'May to July northbound, September to November southbound' is standard; 'around 500 km to Eden' fine; 'Fires Near Me' app is the NSW RFS app (name correct).
Heading 'Sapphire Coast' in title/H1 under-targets the more common query 'NSW south coast camping'.
